$comment: Template for MCP-capable clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Cline, Windsurf, Codex). Copy this block into your client's mcpServers config and replace SKILL_DIR with the absolute path to the traecnclaw-mcp skill folder. Two entry points are provided: the skill launcher (recommended) and the direct mcp-server.js path (fallback).

traecn._comment: Option A (recommended): use the skill launcher script.

env._optional_TRAECN_MCP_SERVER_PATH: Set this if mcp-server.js lives outside the skill folder.

traecn-direct._comment: Option B (fallback): point directly at mcp-server.js when the skill launcher cannot auto-locate it.

profiles.public: 20 tools — default for published agent integrations
profiles.ops: 32 tools — adds recovery, cleanup, Solo control, long-queue proof
profiles.full: 36 tools — audits, compatibility checks, every shortcut

envvars.TRAECN_GATEWAY_TOKEN: Gateway auth token; leave empty if auth is disabled
envvars.TRAECN_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE: Tool profile: public | ops | full (default public)
envvars.TRAECN_MCP_SERVER_PATH: Absolute path to mcp-server.js; overrides auto-detection
